intro: Miss Doris filled up with premium every week, like Frank did for ten years. Her car says regular. We measured one month, fixed 15 small leaks (5 at the pump, 5 in the car, 5 in the driver's seat) and measured again: $160 down to $82. No magnets, no pills, just honest numbers. Episode 7 of "Miss Doris's Car".
